items.title: Derived completeness with respect to I extended to B is detected by the restriction functor

items.difficulty_reason: 11 行、导出完备性的限制检测：ideal-of-elements-complete-wrt 引理把 L ∈ D_comp(B, IB) 刻画为对所有局部截面 f ∈ I 有 T(L,f)=0；T(L,f) 的上同调在阿贝尔群范畴中计算，f 看作 A 或 B 中元素无差别；与 D_comp(A,I) 的定义逐字对照即得限制函子的原像恰为 D_comp(B, IB)。承重全在 span 内；1 处引用作导航桩。

primary.label: author lemma environment with its own label lemma-restriction-derived-complete (no canonical tag in the snapshot tag list); statement at source lines 26615-26620

proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: the characterization of membership in D_comp(B, IB) by the vanishing of the Cech-type functor T(L, f) for local sections f of I, the observation that the cohomology of T(L, f) is computed in abelian groups and hence insensitive to viewing f in A or in B, and the immediate comparison with the definition of D_comp(A, I) (source lines 26622-26632)
